name: Numbered Path
easing: path EASE.inOut f6-62; stop pops: spring pop when path reaches each stop
bestFor: Sequential 3-step process told left to right.
notSuitable: More than 3 steps or branching flows.
keyframeTable: stop 2 popped at top of the curve
rest: S-curve with 3 numbered stops + labels
script: An S-curved line draws from the lower left to the right.
Each numbered circle springs in as the line reaches it; its label appears with it.
